en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a church with a tall steeple and clock, alongside a two-story building, both situated in a rural area with a wooded hill in the background and a ploughed field in the foreground. The reverse side is handwritten in Swedish, containing greetings and an address to 'Fröken Anna Edlund, Harvom, Indal.' The card is dated 'Liden den 2/12 14'.
